requirements.name: Relevant degree or demonstrated equivalent

lines.quote: Spectral data processing algorithm development for Boreal's near-infrared sensing instruments (MATLAB)

requirements.note: Degree is MSc Chemistry, not among the requirement's named fields; status reflects the 'demonstrated equivalent competence' alternative based on the quoted spectral-processing algorithm work -- a judgement call for the recruiter under the refuse-to-guess rule.

lines.quote: I am a Finnish citizen and have lived and worked in Finland my entire career, so there are no visa or work-permit considerations.
I have spent close to two decades writing technical documentation, presenting at internal reviews, and collaborating with colleagues in English on a daily basis.
I would relocate again willingly if the fit is right.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any experience you have designing or implementing phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms?
Can you describe any experience you have writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that runs on real hardware under real-time constraints?
Can you describe any experience you have writing Python to production or engineering standards, as opposed to one-off analysis scripts?
Can you describe any hands-on RF test-bench experience you may have, such as with network analysers, spectrum analysers, or anechoic-chamber measurement?
